mapper.select: select GROUP_CONCAT(name order by sales desc separator ',') as nameList, GROUP_CONCAT(sales order by sales desc separator ',') as numberList from (select d.name, sum(all_sales.sale_num) as sales from dish d INNER JOIN ( -- 1、获取单品数量 select od.dish_id, od.number as sale_num from order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o on od.order_id = o.id where o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} and od.dish_id is not null and o.order_time between #{begin} and #{end} UNION ALL -- 2、套餐拆解销量：下单数量*套餐内菜品份数 select sd.dish_id, od.number * sd.copies as sale_num from order_detail od INNER JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN setmeal_dish sd ON od.setmeal_id = sd.setmeal_id where o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} and od.setmeal_id is not null and o.order_time between #{begin} and #{end}) all_sales on d.id = all_sales.dish_id group by d.id, d.name order by sales desc limit 10) t;

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (SELECT #{begin} AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE dt <= #{end}) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS dateList, GROUP_CONCAT(daily_new ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS newUserList, GROUP_CONCAT(total_users ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS totalUserList FROM (SELECT ds.dt, COUNT(u.id) AS daily_new, SUM(COUNT(u.id)) OVER (ORDER BY ds.dt) AS total_users FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN user u ON DATE(u.create_time) = ds.dt GROUP BY ds.dt) t;

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (SELECT #{begin} AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE dt <= #{end}) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS dateList, GROUP_CONCAT(daily_turnover ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS turnoverList FROM (SELECT ds.dt, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS daily_turnover FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE(o.order_time) = ds.dt AND o.status = 5 GROUP BY ds.dt) t;

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS (SELECT #{begin} AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE dt <= #{end}) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS dateList, GROUP_CONCAT(total_cnt ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS orderCountList, GROUP_CONCAT(valid_cnt ORDER BY dt ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS validOrderCountList, SUM(total_cnt) AS totalOrderCount, SUM(valid_cnt) AS validOrderCount, IF(SUM(total_cnt) = 0, 0, ROUND(SUM(valid_cnt) / SUM(total_cnt), 2)) AS orderCompletionRate FROM (SELECT ds.dt, COUNT(o.id) AS total_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = ${@com.sky.entity.Orders@COMPLETED} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_cnt FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE(o.order_time) = ds.dt GROUP BY ds.dt) t;
